info.title: OMA LwM2M Connected UE Report (Object ID 10249)

Connected_UE_Report.label: Connected UE Report
Connected_UE_Report.description: This LWM2M Object provides a range of information related to the connected UEs.

Connected_User_MMEC.label: Connected User MMEC
Connected_User_MMEC.description: MMEC signalled by the UE to the eNB in the RRCConnectionRequest message (see TS 36.331).

Connected_User_M-TMSI.label: Connected User M-TMSI
Connected_User_M-TMSI.description: M-TMSI signalled by the UE to the eNB in the RRCConnectionRequest message (see TS 36.331).

Serving_Cell_(CrowdBox)_eNB_RSRP.label: Serving Cell (CrowdBox) eNB RSRP
Serving_Cell_(CrowdBox)_eNB_RSRP.description: The RSRP of the CrowdBox eNB, as defined in TS 36.133, Section 9.1.4. Range: RSRP_00; RSRP_01 .. RSRP_97

Serving_Cell_(CrowdBox)_eNB_RSRQ.label: Serving Cell (CrowdBox) eNB RSRQ
Serving_Cell_(CrowdBox)_eNB_RSRQ.description: The RSRQ of the CrowdBox eNB, as defined in TS 36.133, Section 9.1.7. Range: RSRQ_-30; RSRQ_-29 .. RSRQ_46

Cumulative_Timing_Advance_per_Connected_.label: Cumulative Timing Advance per Connected User
Cumulative_Timing_Advance_per_Connected_.description: The cumulative timing advance signalled by the eNB to each currently connected UE. This is the sum of the initial timing advance signalled in the MAC payload of the Random Access Response (11 bits, 0 .. 1282) and subsequent adjustments signalled in the MAC PDU of DL-SCH transmissions (6 bits, -31 .. 32). See TS 36.321 for details.

Last_downlink_CQI_report_per_Connected_U.label: Last downlink CQI report per Connected User
Last_downlink_CQI_report_per_Connected_U.description: The last downlink wideband CQI reported by a connected user the eNB. The CQI format is defined in Table 7.2.3-1 of TS 36.213.

Cumulative_Downlink_Throughput_per_Conne.label: Cumulative Downlink Throughput per Connected User
Cumulative_Downlink_Throughput_per_Conne.description: The total number of MAC bytes sent to the connected user over the immediately preceding period specified by the "Cumulative Measurement Window" field. A 32 bit value with range 0..2^32-1.

Cumulative_Uplink_Throughput_per_Connect.label: Cumulative Uplink Throughput per Connected User
Cumulative_Uplink_Throughput_per_Connect.description: The total number of MAC bytes received from the connected user over the immediately preceding period specified by the "Cumulative Measurement Window" field. A 32 bit value with range 0..2^32-1.

Neighbour_Cell_Report.label: Neighbour Cell Report
Neighbour_Cell_Report.description: A link to the "Neighbour Cell Report" object for each neighbour cell reported to the CrowdBox by the connected UE
